== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-02-of-darkness-and-dawn|[[Awakening]] is a mysterious and poorly understood process used by [[Readers]] to transform inanimate objects into powerful, sentient-like artifacts. This permanent procedure grants an object a degree of awareness or rudimentary consciousness that is directly tied to its original purpose and stored [[Intent]]. While the process can change an object's physical appearance, these structural alterations occur only once during the transformation and cannot be altered afterward. An [[Awakened object]] can utilize its existing collection of [[Intent]] to achieve its goals, but it can no longer receive new investments or undergo the [[Awakening]] process a second time. The procedure requires significant time, strength, and an intimate understanding of the object's goals and [[Intent]]. Depending on the item's nature, [[Awakening]] can take anywhere from days to several years. When successful, the process can result in highly unpredictable outcomes; for example, an object might develop a personality that influences the senses or minds of those nearby. In some instances, a human being can become bound to these items during the procedure, a state referred to as being [[Soulbound]]. This connection allows the individual to draw power from the object, though it is not entirely clear how such [[Awakened items]] affect their users.}}
